trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no shortcut: finish the story, clear the 100% checklist, then mop up the side and secret trophies in any order you like.
steps: Finish all five story chapters.
Reach 100% completion for A Long Road.
Clear every remaining side, activity and secret trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy from the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Play through the intro as directed and it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening.
Follow the on-screen prompts through Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Play every Chapter 1 mission in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude.
steps: Play through all Chapter 1 missions.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Complete the final Chapter 1 mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Keep playing the main missions in order; it pops when the chapter closes.
steps: Play through all Chapter 2 missions.
Unlock both characters playing together after Coffee Break.
Complete the final Chapter 2 mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Main missions only; it pops at the chapter's end.
steps: Play through all Chapter 3 missions.
Finish the chapter's closing mission.
Free-roam opens wider after the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. One chapter left after this one; play the missions in order and it pops at the end.
steps: Play through all Chapter 4 missions.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
Save manually at the chapter's end, missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for the final mission. There is no mission replay, so save manually before you start it and finish it in one go.
steps: Save manually before the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end.
Free-roam continues after the credits for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It comes up naturally in the story; finish the mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Play the mission through.
Finish it to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the story flow; complete it and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Play the heist through.
Finish it to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. It arrives in the story on its own; finish the mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Play the mission through.
Finish it to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. Complete it in the story flow and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Play the mission through.
Finish it to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown. A takedown at the airport; finish the mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Play the mission through.
Finish it to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. Complete the operation in the story flow and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Play the mission through.
Finish it to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list: reach 100% completion. The checklist only becomes viewable after the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), but progress you make during the story already counts. It asks for robberies, collectibles, challenges and activities, not everything in the game.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Clear the checklist: robberies, shooting range, drone races, Bret quests.
Finish the remaining collectibles and 50 of the 80 challenges.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida. There are 397 stunt spots in the world, so you have room to spare. Jumps, airtime and near-misses all count; use ramps and fast cars and check your count in Stats.
steps: Find ramps and jumps around Leonida.
Land clean stunts in a fast car or bike.
Track progress in Stats until 250 is reached.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once: nine types in total, from the shooting range to fishing, races, the arcade and bowling. One try each is enough, no wins needed.
steps: Visit the shooting range and fire a round.
Try fishing, a race, the arcade and bowling.
Check the activity list until all nine types are tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge is a short weapon drill with a score target; learn the target layout, then run it clean and fast. Pistols first, then work through the rest.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open the challenges.
Learn each drill's target layout.
Gold all 42 challenges, one weapon at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course; learn the gates, cut corners where the course allows, and win once per location.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Learn the gate layout on a practice run.
Win at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street, off-road and water races all count, as long as each race is a different one. Pick a fast, well-handling vehicle for each surface.
steps: Enter races across Leonida, on road and off.
Win each race once.
Reach 20 different race wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take the challenge, and out-fish him: steady reeling beats fast reeling, and the right bait matters.
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot.
Accept his fishing challenge.
Out-fish Cal to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick any cabinet, and play it to the end. You do not need a high score, just a finished game.
steps: Enter an arcade.
Pick any cabinet and start a game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand with its final mission. Andy's quests are Lucia-only, so play them as Lucia whenever the strand is open.
steps: Play Andy's missions as Lucia.
Follow the strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Andy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand with its final mission. Kenton can be temporarily unavailable during the story, but he comes back later, so keep checking his strand after the story.
steps: Play Kenton's missions when his strand is open.
Follow the strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Kenton.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand with its final mission. Work through his missions in order until the strand closes with the finale.
steps: Play Billy's missions in order.
Follow the strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Billy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers show as side missions on the map; finish a whole strand, not just one mission, and eight finished strands pop the trophy.
steps: Find stranger missions on the map.
Finish each strand to its end.
Complete 8 strands in total.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand with its final mission. Work through his missions in order until the strand closes with the finale.
steps: Play Randy's missions in order.
Follow the strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Randy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand with its final mission. Tyrone's quests are Jason-only, so play them as Jason whenever the strand is open.
steps: Play Tyrone's missions as Jason.
Follow the strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, but the first one can be lost forever: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning. She says she wants to meditate; follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That meditation may count toward the trophy, and it is gone once Chapter 1 ends. The last spot needs both characters together, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Note: 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so a missed Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you A Long Road.
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house.
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, meditate at spots as both characters.
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are Jason-only; follow his hunting strand, track the unique animal, and take it down cleanly.
steps: Play Bret's hunting missions as Jason.
Track the unique animal he asks for.
Hunt it and finish the strand.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida, in shops, stashes and mission rewards. A set is complete when every card in it is collected; three finished sets pop the trophy.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida.
Finish one full card set.
Complete 3 sets in total.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are marked around the map; walk up, use the WAiNK interaction, and move on. The counter climbs fast in dense areas like Vice City.
steps: Find WAiNK spots on the map.
Use the WAiNK interaction at each one.
Reach 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges sit in eight groups of ten, covering combat, driving, exploration and more. Pick the easy groups first; you only need 50 of the 80.
steps: Open the challenges list.
Clear the easiest groups first.
Complete 50 challenges in total.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Commit crimes together until four stars show, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
steps: Bring your partner along.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and escape until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each fast, and keep the wanted level alive between them; do not let the stars clear until the third robbery is done.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three close shops.
Rob the first shop, then the second, then the third.
Keep your wanted level alive through all three.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or scan counts; city traffic, parked cars and mission vehicles all add up. Scan as you go during the story and the count climbs on its own.
steps: Drive or scan new vehicles as you meet them.
Check car parks and traffic in Vice City.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout works best.
steps: Find a group of at least five enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Get to the airport, grab a plane, and take off without following the schedule: a stolen plane leaving the runway pops the trophy.
steps: Go to VCIA airport.
Steal a plane on the tarmac.
Take off for an unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos, the military tanks. Push your wanted level high until the army rolls in, then survive the Rhinos: destroy one or outrun the response.
steps: Raise your wanted level until Rhinos deploy.
Face a Rhino tank.
Destroy it or escape the response.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras spotting you. Plan the entry, take the goods, and leave before anyone notices.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Avoid cameras and witnesses.
Take the goods and leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big bank jobs: crack the vault, grab the cash, and get out before the response closes in. Five successful vault escapes pop the silver.
steps: Find a bank vault job.
Crack the vault and grab the cash.
Escape, then repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, crack it open, take the cash, and lose the wanted level before you are caught.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it and crack it open.
Take the cash and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited; drive, fly and sail into every corner, including the Keys and the swamps, until all 52 are marked.
steps: Open the map and note unvisited areas.
Drive, fly or sail into each one.
Visit all 52 areas of Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops.
steps: Find an illegal operation for one gang.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for all 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beach bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view; the trophy pops as you drink.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a beach bar and order a cocktail.
Enjoy the drink with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom window, in the spirit of the old games, and the trophy pops as you burst out.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive a car at the showroom glass.
Smash out through the window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, pick up a ball, and bowl a full game with a proper follow-through.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling.
Bowl through with a full follow-through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. Build your partnership through shared activities with your partner until a big public moment lands; keep playing together and it comes up on its own.
steps: Play activities together with your partner.
Build the partnership through shared moments.
Trigger the big public partnership moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse. Across the story and free roam, the game offers choices that shape your path; keep choosing and the counter climbs until the trophy pops. Avoid the Irredeemable profile, which cannot be undone.
steps: Play the story and take the choices it offers.
Keep choosing in free-roam moments too.
Stay clear of the Irredeemable profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail something, then succeed on the retry. Pick an activity or objective, fail it once, then nail it on the second attempt.
steps: Attempt an activity or objective.
Fail it once.
Succeed on the immediate retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides weird events; explore odd spots, especially at night, until something unexplainable happens in front of you.
steps: Explore strange spots around Leonida.
Visit them at night.
Witness the odd event when it triggers.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian and knock them down like a bowling pin.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian.
Strike them with a melee drive-by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total climbs toward $250,000.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food and vehicles all count; buy what you need as you play and the total climbs toward $100,000.
steps: Shop for clothes, weapons and gear.
Buy vehicles and upgrades too.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are sold around Leonida; buy each one to store your vehicles, and the trophy pops when the eighth is yours.
steps: Find garage properties for sale.
Buy each garage.
Own all 8 garages.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, add a vehicle you own or find, and repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle.
Register 10 vehicles in total.
